src: Small bowel biopsies showed villous atrophy and increased intraepithelial lymphocytes, consistent with celiac disease (Marsh 3b).
Colonic biopsies in ulcerative colitis showed crypt abscesses and crypt distortion without granulomas.
A low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) may rupture and give rise to pseudomyxoma peritonei.
